title: Half and Half · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Half and Half · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar object and a partner. The lead draws one half and the partner completes the other half without discussing the object. The other players can recognize the completed object. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Half and Half, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The other players can recognize the completed object.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The other players can recognize the completed object.
